modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
I gave FLUX 3 Max, MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, Kling 4.0 and Seedance 2.0 the same 4 photoreal stills and the same prompts: a face with a spoken line, a laughing group, hands with poker chips, and a burning street.

Full prompts & results below: https://t.co/0IaupwvndM

originalPrompt: Slow push-in on the woman leaning against the wall. She holds the camera's gaze, exhales softly through her nose, and a small knowing smile forms at one corner of her mouth. She says quietly: "I already said yes." Natural daylight, real skin texture, subtle handheld breathing in the camera. Quiet room tone.
